content_units: Cozy Family Movie Night Snapshot
Best fit for your group:   light, funny, adventurous, fast-moving, and broadly age-friendly  .
I ranked the options by how well they match   two adults + a 12-year-old + a 9-year-old  , while avoiding anything too intense, romantic, or long.
Ranked Picks for Your Group
Rank   Movie   Runtime   Fit for Your Group
1   Paddington 2   103 min   Warmest all-ages crowd-pleaser with gentle comedy and zero real content risk
2   The Mitchells vs. the Machines   114 min   Big laughs, family energy, and enough action to keep both kids and adults engaged
3   Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse   117 min   Stylish, exciting, and funny, with broad appeal for kids and adults alike
4   Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade   127 min   A classic adventure with humor and parent-kid appeal, though slightly more intense
5   Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle   119 min   Very entertaining and funny, but a bit more teen-oriented in humor than the top picks
Why These 5 Made the Cut
Option 1:   Paddington 2     Sweet, funny, and easy for every age in the room to enjoy     Best overall family-safe pick
- It is the safest “everyone will probably have a good time” choice, with charming comedy for the kids and enough wit for adults.
Option 2:   The Mitchells vs. the Machines     Energetic family comedy with heart and visual fun     Best modern family comedy
- It delivers constant jokes and action without getting too scary, and the family dynamic works especially well for a mixed-age movie night.
Option 3:   Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse     Clever, exciting superhero adventure with strong humor     Best for energy and style
- It balances action and comedy really well, and both adults and kids usually find something to love in its fast, inventive storytelling.
Option 4:   Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade     Classic adventure with humor, puzzles, and great duo chemistry     Best classic adventure choice
- It is a strong family adventure pick because it feels exciting and funny rather than romantic, though some scenes may be a little intense for the 9-year-old.
Option 5:   Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle     Funny ensemble adventure with lots of momentum     Best if you want the broadest comedy-action mix
- It is very watchable and crowd-friendly, but some humor lands more toward older kids and adults than true all-ages family viewing.
Why the Others Ranked Lower
-   Ghostbusters  : Funny and classic, but some supernatural/scary elements may feel less cozy for a 9-year-old than your top 5.
-   Knives Out  : Smart and fun for adults, but the murder-mystery tone is less ideal for a cozy family night with a 9-year-old.
-   Jurassic Park  : Excellent adventure, but the suspense and dinosaur scares make it less cozy than the other options.
